title: Falco bridge+falcodump: Update to Falco libs 0.17.1

notes.body:
With 0.17.1 it seems the `userspace` directory has been abandoned (at least on my build system).

```
diff --git a/cmake/modules/FindSinsp.cmake b/cmake/modules/FindSinsp.cmake
index 6060b845c6..1313652077 100644
--- a/cmake/modules/FindSinsp.cmake
+++ b/cmake/modules/FindSinsp.cmake
@@ -37,7 +37,7 @@ if(NOT SINSP_FOUND)
   find_path(_sinsp_include_dirs NO_CACHE
     NAMES libsinsp/sinsp.h
     HINTS "${SINSP_INCLUDEDIR}" "${SINSP_HINTS}/include"
-    PATH_SUFFIXES falcosecurity/userspace
+    PATH_SUFFIXES falcosecurity
     /usr/include
     /usr/local/include
   )
@@ -48,7 +48,7 @@ if(NOT SINSP_FOUND)
   find_path(_scap_include_dir NO_CACHE
     NAMES scap.h
     HINTS "${SINSP_INCLUDEDIR}" "${SINSP_HINTS}/include"
-    PATH_SUFFIXES falcosecurity/userspace/libscap
+    PATH_SUFFIXES falcosecurity/libscap
     /usr/include
     /usr/local/include
   )
diff --git a/tools/macos-setup-patches/falco-uthash_h-install.patch b/tools/macos-setup-patches/falco-uthash_h-install.patch
index de818ffd0a..5a372d1b15 100644
--- a/tools/macos-setup-patches/falco-uthash_h-install.patch
+++ b/tools/macos-setup-patches/falco-uthash_h-install.patch
@@ -1,9 +1,9 @@
---- falco-libs-0.14.1/cmake/modules/libscap.cmake.orig 2024-03-25 22:46:40
-+++ falco-libs-0.14.1/cmake/modules/libscap.cmake      2024-03-25 22:46:10
+--- falco-libs-0.17.1/cmake/modules/libscap.cmake.orig 2024-05-29 13:33:12
++++ falco-libs-0.17.1/cmake/modules/libscap.cmake      2024-05-31 11:46:10
 @@ -139,5 +139,6 @@
                FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")
- install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/libscap/scap_config.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/userspace/libscap)
- install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/libscap/scap_strl_config.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/userspace/libscap)
-+install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/uthash-prefix/src/uthash/src/uthash.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/userspace/libscap)
+ install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/libscap/scap_config.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/libscap)
+ install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/libscap/scap_strl_config.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/libscap)
++install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/uthash-prefix/src/uthash/src/uthash.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${LIBS_PACKAGE_NAME}/libscap)
  install(FILES ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/libscap/libscap.pc DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig)
  endif()
```
Thanks. I added your changes and added you as co-author.
